results.title: Pune: Retired Lt Gen Ashok Joshi Dies After Falling From Building Terrace In Salunkhe Vihar
results.description: Joshi lived on the third floor of a residential building in Salunkhe Vihar, Wanowrie. According to the police, around 9.30 am on Wednesday, he told his domestic help that he intended to go to the terrace to get some sunlight as he was feeling cold
